$comment: KalVoice understanding corpus. Each case lists acceptable outcomes in `expect`: an intent object (a PARTIAL serde form of KalVoiceIntent; every key given must match, `_target` names the fixture workspace/thread/providers the command must resolve to), "clarify" (ask a specific follow-up; nothing runs) or "none" (do not execute; a refusal is correct). Expectations describe what a good local assistant SHOULD do, not what the current grammar does. Synthetic text only; no recorded speech. Categories: direct, paraphrase, followup, reference, ambiguous, negative, asr (speech-recognition-style variants).
